email.subject: Tutor students in New York — list your sessions free
body: Hi {{first_name}},

Students across New York look for help with calculus, statistics, chemistry, essays and code. On TrustSquare a tutor lists a session in about a minute: pick your subject and level, set your rate (for example $75 an hour) and choose your neighborhoods — or online.

Looking for a tutor instead? The second link shows what is already listed in New York.
